brief: The generation of objects that a run of the CPython garbage collector collected. A collection of a generation also collects all younger generations, so 2 is a full collection.
additional_context: On free-threaded builds of CPython (3.13+), the garbage collector isn't generational: every collection scans all objects. Automatic collections report generation 0, and explicit collections report the generation that was requested, but all of them are full collections.
